subject.title: fix(macos): fresh setup no longer stalls starting gateway

question: Is the existing live proof plus completed exact-head macOS checks sufficient to land the final Gateway lifecycle head, or should a new signed-app run exercise the generation-isolation follow-up first?
rationale: The central behavior has strong live proof, but the final production commit adjusts asynchronous readiness ownership after the specifically identified signed-app proof head; accepting that incremental availability risk is a maintainer landing judgment.

options.title: Land after exact-head checks
options.body: Refresh the branch and merge once the required macOS and native-inventory checks pass on the final head.

options.title: Require fresh signed-app proof
options.body: Run the final head through healthy reuse, stale-service repair, and overlapping restart behavior in a signed macOS app before landing.

recommendation.title: Land after exact-head checks
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and merge once the required macOS and native-inventory checks pass on the final head.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history shows direct ownership of the lifecycle design and every review-driven follow-up in this PR.
